equilibrium_reference.scope: Independent exactly flat-QF equilibrium reference; psi and material unchanged, populations regenerated, not the bitwise native-population replay
equilibrium_reference.explanation: The native accepted state has a nonzero hole QF of about 9.746e-12 V. Its removal accounts for the 3.77e-10 relative hole population change; this is distinct from serialization roundoff.

notes: All source-kernel controls retain the legacy contact electric-field choice and ionization coefficients.
Rows are normalized with identical frozen C0 and D0. Poisson/contact replacement rows are outside the explicit kernel replay.
The flat-QF reference changes populations; it is not the bitwise imported-state replay.
The ordinary private owner uses modern constants; matching statistics alone does not establish zero-bias acceptance.
